image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rough, encrusted rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal shell plates surrounded by a textured, leathery girdle covered in fine bristles or scales. The background consists of pink coralline algae and grey rock textures.
